svg.aria-label: How 64 music positions align to the rule keys
svg.text: A · chord-seq mode — 64 subbeat queries, 8 chord keys (key_stride = 8)
key PE sits at the slot centre c·8 + 3.5 — every subbeat in a slot reads its own chord
B · self-derived mode — 64 queries, 64 keys (key_stride = 1, causal)
proxy = ar_to_rule(h[t]) — one 16-d vector per subbeat, no chord labels anywhere
